paper_metadata.title: Bimodal grained Mg–0.5Gd–xMn alloys with high strength and low-cost fabricated by low-temperature extrusion

evidence.quote: Mg–0.5Gd–xMn (x = 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0 wt.%) alloys system was developed by the low-temperature extrusion at 250 °C.
